title: Mystic Forge: Material Transmutation Chamber
description: The user operates an arcane transmutation chamber where a dragon statue and an iridescent abalone shell are displayed on twin pedestals. By manipulating material properties like iridescence intensity, attenuation color, attenuation distance, thickness, and transmission on both models, the user must match a target material recipe shown on a floating HUD panel, blending the visual qualities between the two artifacts.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with three and three/addons from cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0). Load both IridescenceAbalone.glb and DragonAttenuation.glb using GLTFLoader. Place the abalone on the left pedestal at (-2, 0, 0) and the dragon on the right pedestal at (2, 0, 0). Create simple box-geometry pedestals beneath each model. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at (0, 3, 7) looking at origin. Add an HDR-like environment using PMREMGenerator with a RoomEnvironment from three/addons. Add one DirectionalLight and one AmbientLight. Enable OrbitControls with damping. Build a dat.gui or HTML-based control panel with these 8 parameters: (1) Dragon Attenuation Distance (0.01-10), (2) Dragon Attenuation Color RGB, (3) Dragon Transmission (0-1), (4) Dragon Thickness (0-5), (5) Abalone Iridescence Intensity (0-1), (6) Abalone Iridescence IOR (1.0-2.33), (7) Abalone Metalness (0-1), (8) Abalone Roughness (0-1). On load, traverse each model's scene and store references to all MeshPhysicalMaterial instances. When sliders change, update the corresponding material properties and set needsUpdate=true. Generate a random target recipe with specific values for all 8 parameters displayed in a fixed-position HTML overlay panel at top-right showing target values. Add a 'Validate' button that checks if all 8 current values are within 0.15 tolerance of the target values. Display a green checkmark per matching parameter and red X per mismatched one. When all 8 match, show a success banner with a particle burst effect using a simple BufferGeometry point system. Add a 'New Recipe' button to randomize a new target. Track and display the number of successful matches. Ensure renderer uses tone mapping (ACESFilmic) and outputColorSpace sRGB for proper material appearance.
